title: Emergency!
description:

An outspoken, feminist journalist covering the paramedics manages to alienate both the fire department and Rampart Emergency staff.

title: Emergency!
description:

DeSoto maneuvers Gage into a blind date with his wife's cousin; Brackett must operate on a newlywed husband felled by gunshot wounds.

title: Emergency!
description:

Gage's musical efforts irritate Station 51; rescue calls range from frostbite to a man trapped beneath his sliding canyon-home.

title: Emergency!
description:

An exhausted and emotionally upset woman doctor disappears from the hospital; Gage tries to help DeSoto with a marital difficulty.

title: The A-Team
description:

The team rescues an heiress (Lori Lethin) from terrorists, only to have her insist on returning to save her terrorist lover.

title: The A-Team
description:

Mercenaries capture B.A., Face and Murdock, and hold them at a dairy farm, leaving Tawnia and Hannibal to devise a rescue.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E22 — Semi-Friendly Persuasion
The team abides by a cult's nonviolent philosophy to defeat corrupt townspeople who burned their community building.

title: The A-Team
description:

The team recalls incidents of Murdock's bravery and loyalty while he lies badly wounded by a bullet meant for Hannibal.

title: The A-Team
description:

The team flies to Miami to wage war against gangsters threatening to take over a resort hotel owned by two sisters.

title: The A-Team
description:

Tawnia recruits the team to save her adventurer fiancé, captured by Amazon River pirates while searching for a lost city.

title: The A-Team
description:

The captured team discovers a secret in the jungle and must enlist El Cajon's assistance to destroy a deadly installation.

title: The A-Team
description:

The team helps a fire chief (Stepfanie Kramer) save her one-truck company from takeover by a larger operation.

title: The A-Team
description:

The team helps brother-and-sister lumberjacks thwart a crooked union boss intent on driving them out of business.
